name: Brand Template Enforcer
description: Ensure every generated PowerPoint deck or Word document starts from the correct bundled or SharePoint-hosted brand template.
author: Doug Bellingeri
coverImageAlt: A dark master frame aligns a landscape presentation panel and portrait document to the same cyan grid, secured by one orange template pin.
coverImagePrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: AI.Tedt.org skill gallery cover
Primary request: Create a premium editorial illustration of an approved brand template physically governing both presentation and document outputs before content is produced.
Scene/backdrop: A warm paper-toned design workshop with a single compact alignment apparatus and generous negative space, not a software screen.
Subject: One dark-slate master frame with precise cyan margin rails receives a landscape presentation panel and a portrait document sheet from opposite sides; both emerge aligned to the same modular grid, color tabs, and recurring footer bar, while one small orange locking pin secures the approved template.
Style/medium: Premium editorial illustration with tactile dimensional detail, layered cut paper, matte ceramic framing, and subtle translucent acrylic guides.
Composition/framing: Exact 16:10 landscape; crop-safe centered master frame; the two output formats remain visually distinct but unified; no essential detail in the outer 8%; strong simple geometry legible on a small gallery card.
Lighting/mood: Controlled, trustworthy, orderly, quietly technical, with restrained cyan backlighting and a sparing warm orange accent.
Color palette: Warm paper #F8F6F0, slate #101820, navy #00446F, cyan #00A9E0, sparing orange #E86027.
Constraints: No text, letters, numbers, placeholder copy, interface labels, logos, trademarks, or watermark; no pseudo-writing or writing-like lines; no paw imagery or paw logo; no cats or cat silhouettes; no Microsoft Office icons, product UI, browser chrome, Microsoft Fluent gradients, or Microsoft branding.
